title: Sharp Spectral-Cluster Density Bounds on Manifolds
exact_target: Can intermediate-rank subspaces attain the predicted sharp spectral-cluster density bounds for every indicated exponent?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003218 (OWR-14751-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems and Effective Theories (2016), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2016/43, pp. 2465--2511. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 23, 24.
Frank--Sabin spectral cluster bounds (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The exponent definitions and the source\textquotesingle s intermediate-rank formulation were recovered from PDF pages 23--24. The report proves the sharpness construction for $M=S^2$ and asks the general compact manifold case; that special case is not substituted for the full target. Source asymptotic comparability conventions for $\sim$ are retained.
